texts.AISettingGroup:Title: AI Configuration
texts.Setting:AI.AutomaticGenerationEnabled:De: When enabled, AI analysis runs automatically on new application intake (subject to form-level AI configuration).
texts.Setting:AI.ManualGenerationEnabled:Descr: When enabled, users with appropriate permissions can manually generate or regenerate AI analysis.
texts.Setting:AI.ReportingEnabled:Description: When enabled, users with the AI Reporting permission can access the AI Reporting dashboard.
texts.LegalDisclaimer:Title: Legal Disclaimer
texts.LegalDisclaimer:Body: The Platform does not provide legal, financial, or policy advice, and may not be relied on to determine program eligibility or make final decisions in place of the user, who will be solely responsible for the use of the Platform, including the review and validation of Unity AI outputs before use.

texts.AI:ApplicationAnalysisDisabled: AI application analysis is not enabled.

texts.PromptInUseHelp: In use: the version Unity uses, which is the highest active version. To go back a version, make the one in use inactive.
texts.AISetup:ApiVersionHelp: The Azure OpenAI API version sent with every call to this deployment (?api-version=), in Unity and AI Reporting, for example 2024-10-21 or 2025-04-01-preview. Use the version Azure documents for the deployment, then run Test.
texts.AISetup:ApiVersionNotConfigured: This model has no valid API version. Edit the model and enter one, for example 2024-10-21.
texts.AISetup:AIReportingNotConfiguredHelp: AI Reporting is unavailable in every program until both its chat and embedding models are chosen.
texts.AISetup:EmbeddingChangeWarning: Changing the embedding model re-prepares AI Reporting for every program: each shows "Preparing AI Reporting" on its next question while its tables are embedded again.
texts.AISetup:TypeHelp: Chat models answer AI operations. Embedding models turn text into vectors for AI Reporting.
texts.AISetup:NoPromptHelp: Every version of this operation's prompt is inactive in AI Prompts, so no version is in use and the operation fails. Make one active.
texts.AISetup:ExecutionModeHelp: Sequential scores one section at a time. Parallel scores all sections at once: faster, but more load on the Azure rate limit. Batch sends every section in one request: fewest calls, but one failure loses all sections.
texts.PromptDeleteConfirm: Delete {0} version {1}? This cannot be undone.
texts.AISetup:EndpointNotConfigured: Azure:OpenAI:Endpoint is not configured for this environment.
texts.AISetup:ApiKeyNotConfigured: Azure:OpenAI:ApiKey is not configured for this environment.
texts.AISetup:EndpointInternal: This is an OpenShift service inside the cluster, so it has no link. Unity checks it below.
texts.AISetup:EndpointNoHealthCheck: Reachable (HTTP {0}), but it has no /healthz status.
texts.AISetup:EndpointStatusFailed: The status check failed. Use Test on a model instead.
texts.AISetup:NameHelp: The Azure OpenAI deployment name, for example gpt-5-mini.
texts.AISetup:NoActiveModels: Add an active model before configuring operations.
texts.AI:SetupModelNameDuplicate: An AI model named '{name}' already exists.
texts.AI:SetupProviderNotSupported: The AI provider '{provider}' is not supported.
texts.AI:SetupModelInUse: The AI model '{name}' is used by {operations}. Point those operations at another model first.
texts.AI:SetupModelTypeInvalid: '{type}' is not a valid model type.
texts.AI:SetupModelNotChat: {name} is an embedding model. Choose a chat model.
texts.AI:SetupModelNotEmbedding: {name} is a chat model. Choose an embedding model.
texts.AI:SetupExecutionModeNotUsed: {name} always runs Sequential. Only Application Scoring can use Parallel or Batch.
texts.AI:SetupExecutionModeInvalid: '{mode}' is not a valid execution mode.
texts.AI:SetupOperationUnknown: '{name}' is not a built-in AI operation.
texts.AI:PromptVersionInUse: {name} version {version} is the version in use. Make it inactive, or make a higher version active, before deleting it.
texts.AI:ReportingModelsNotSet: AI Reporting's models are not set in AI Setup yet. Ask IT Operations to choose them in Unity Admin -> AI Setup.
texts.AI:SetupApiVersionInvalid: '{version}' is not an Azure OpenAI API version. Use the form 2024-10-21 or 2025-04-01-preview.
texts.AI:ReportingNotSetUp: AI Reporting is not set up for this tenant yet. Ask IT Admin to set up Metabase for the tenant on the Reporting tab.
